title: tc-network-graph
description:
Any nodes and links, laid out by force – clusters and bridges showing for themselves – with groups in their own inks,
the most-linked named, a node's neighbourhood lit on hover or focus, nodes that can be dragged into place, and a
table view.

nodes.description: The nodes; when empty, the nodes the links name

links.description: The links; when empty, links are read from the rows in `data`

source.description: For links read from `data`: the field naming one end; by default "source", or "from"

target.description: For links read from `data`: the field naming the other end; by default "target", or "to"

value.description: For links read from `data`: the link's strength field; by default "value", else 1

maxLabels.description: How many nodes are named beside their circles at most – fewer when the chart is narrow

dragNodes.description: Lets the pointer drag a node; it stays where it's dropped until double-clicked

canvasThreshold.description: Above this many nodes the links are painted on a canvas

networkLabels.description: The network graph's own words, merged over defaultNetworkGraphLabels

heading.description: The heading, and the chart's name

highlight.description: What to emphasise: an index, a label, a list of them, "max", "min", "first", "last", "none", or a test

format.description: How values are written: "number", "integer", "percent", "compact", "currency", Intl options, or a function

unit.description: The unit after each value: "%", "ms", " runs"

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

height.description: The plot's height in px; by default the chart's own for its width

still.description: Draws everything at once: no entrance and no transitions

duration.description: How long a move takes, in ms; by default the chart's own

hideLabels.description: Leaves the values off the marks

hideTooltip.description: No tooltip on hover or focus

bare.description: No card: just the plot, for a chart inside another component

view.description: The chart or the same numbers as a table. Changed by the Table button unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

labels.description: The words it shows and says, merged over defaultChartLabels

NetworkNode.description: A node: `label` defaults to the id; `group` picks its ink; `size` its area (else its number of links)

NetworkLink.description: A link between two node ids; `value` makes it thicker, shorter and stronger

FormatName.description: Number and date formats, through Intl; the default locale is en-US
